render_point_depth — 3D render op

• Data kinds: points → depth

• Call: import match3d; match3d.render_point_depth(points, K, size, R=None, t=None) (or ops3d.get("render_point_depth"))

Usage

Point set → a depth image (z-buffer; each pixel takes the depth of its nearest point). For synthesising observations and inspection samples.
